newsitem.title: USA: Adelphia sells $350 mln in notes.
newsitem.headline: Adelphia sells $350 mln in notes.

text.p: Adelphia Communications Corp said it has sold $350 million of its 9-7/8 percent Senior Notes due 2007 in a private placement.
The placement was primarily to institutional investors, it said. The proceeds to Adelphia amounted to $342,125,000, it said.
The transaction is expected to close on February 26.

Adelphia said it intends to use some of the net proceeds from the offering to redeem, purchase or otherwise retire a portion of its 12-1/2 percent Senior Notes due 2002, and to use the remainder to repay other existing debts.
Adelphia is a cable television operator.
